setting.title: Enable Agent Browser Use
setting.description: Show setup guidance only; this does not install a skill or gate Browser API commands.

setting.description: Cleaned removes embedding/headless user-agent tokens. Applies after daemon/plugin restart; native system-webview identity hook is unavailable.
